_comment: Historical population classifier retained for the complete-index census.
No .ct recordings are committed. tools/fixtures/recordings.json declares the
generated output population and its immutable inputs; prepare-recordings.mjs
records it before use, while check-recordings-policy.mjs checks every indexed path.
